# Murmur

Self-populating TensorDB wiki and bulletin board for SuperInstance.

## Overview

Murmur is a knowledge management system that organizes itself. Built on the TensorDB knowledge graph, it provides:

- **Self-Populating Wiki** - Automatically organizes information
- **Bulletin Board** - Community-driven updates
- **Knowledge Graph** - TensorDB-powered connections
- **Real-time Updates** - Live event streaming

## Features

- **Auto-Organization** - Content structures itself
- **Semantic Connections** - AI-powered linking
- **Community Features** - Boards and threads
- **TensorDB Integration** - Knowledge tensor operations

## Quick Start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/SuperInstance/Murmur.git
cd Murmur
pnpm install
pnpm dev
```

Visit http://localhost:3004

## Development

```bash
# Install dependencies
pnpm install

# Run dev server
pnpm dev

# Build for production
pnpm build

# Type check
pnpm type-check
```

## Testing

```bash
pnpm test          # run tests once
pnpm test:watch    # watch mode
```

Tests use [Vitest](https://vitest.dev/) and cover:
- `cn()` utility — Tailwind class merging, conditionals, conflict resolution
- `ModuleRegistry` — module discovery, state tracking, resource updates, statistics
- Filesystem integration — package scanning, hidden dir skipping, state preservation on rescan

## Tech Stack

- Next.js 15
- React 19
- TypeScript 5
- Tailwind CSS 4
- @superinstance/knowledge-tensor
